_doc: English texts for the data files, loaded only by the English version (/en/). Same keys as archetypes.json and coaches.json: only label and desc are replaced, numbers stay in the original files.

floor-general.label: Pure point guard
floor-general.desc: Runs the offense, sets the pace, few mistakes. Doesn't need to score to matter.

scoring-pg.label: Scoring point guard
scoring-pg.desc: A playmaker who carries the scoring load, often off the dribble.

combo-guard.label: Combo guard
combo-guard.desc: Scores every way, runs the offense now and then, defense is negotiable.

two-way-guard.label: Two-way guard
two-way-guard.desc: Guards the other team's best guard and handles the ball. The glue of a backcourt.

sharpshooter.label: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.desc: Pure spacing. Moves the defense without touching the ball.

three-and-d.label: 3&D
three-and-d.desc: Shoots from deep and guards the best player. Very low usage by design.

slasher.label: Slasher
slasher.desc: Lives on drives and drawn fouls. Questionable outside shot.

iso-scorer.label: Isolation scorer
iso-scorer.desc: Creates his own shot against anyone. Needs the ball.

all-around-star.label: All-around star
all-around-star.desc: No holes: scores, creates, defends. The engine of everything.

point-forward.label: Point forward
point-forward.desc: Runs the offense from the wing. Creates size mismatches on the perimeter.

two-way-wing.label: Two-way wing
two-way-wing.desc: A reliable second option and the team's best perimeter defender.

athletic-wing.label: Athletic wing
athletic-wing.desc: Transition, cuts, verticality. Punishes slow teams.

stretch-four.label: Stretch four
stretch-four.desc: Pulls the opposing center away from the rim. Opens the lane for everyone.

power-forward.label: Classic power forward
power-forward.desc: Physicality, rebounds, points near the rim. Zero spacing.

glue-forward.label: Glue forward
glue-forward.desc: Hardly ever scores but makes everything work: defense, rebounds, passing.

post-scorer.label: Post scorer
post-scorer.desc: Attacks with his back to the basket, forces double teams, frees the shooters.

dominant-center.label: Dominant center
dominant-center.desc: First option from the paint. Changes the opposing defense on his own.

playmaking-center.label: Playmaking center
playmaking-center.desc: The offense runs through his passes from the elbow. Slow but smart.

rim-runner.label: Rim runner
rim-runner.desc: Screen and roll. Finishes, doesn't create. Never shoots.

defensive-anchor.label: Defensive anchor
defensive-anchor.desc: Protects the rim and that's it. A passenger on offense.

stretch-center.label: Stretch center
stretch-center.desc: Plays in the post but spaces the floor from outside: the defense can't pack the paint.

midrange-scorer.label: Midrange scorer
midrange-scorer.desc: Lives in the in-between: pull-ups and curls off screens, very little from three.

stella.label: Everything through the star
stella.desc: Builds the team around the first option. He scores more, the other four make do.

sistema.label: System first
sistema.desc: The ball moves and the defense helps, but the star is no longer the center of everything.

difesa.label: Defense first
difesa.desc: Locked-down half court and a slow pace. You score little, but you give up even less.

fisico.label: Muscle and rebounds
fisico.desc: A tough game, you own the glass. But the outside shot gets lost along the way.

corsa.label: Always running
corsa.desc: Fast breaks on every possession. Lots of points scored, and plenty given up too.

tiro.label: Spread floor, threes
tiro.desc: Five men outside and the basket wide open behind the arc. Nobody defends the paint.

pickroll.label: Sets and repetition
pickroll.desc: The same play over and over, drilled to boredom. Few turnovers and few off nights.

versatile.label: Switch everything
versatile.desc: Switch on every screen and pressure the ball handler. But the offense produces less.

equilibrio.label: No favorites
equilibrio.desc: Nobody gets special treatment. More consistency, fewer memorable nights.

dentro.label: Inside game
dentro.desc: Ball to the big in the post and second-chance shots. You shoot from outside only when you must.
